description: Tailor a supplied CV/resume to a specific job posting. A successful tailoring returns the actual tailored CV and before/after assessments, plus role-fit notes, interview preparation and a cover letter when available. A role mismatch or a finding of possible added or omitted facts can prevent delivery of a tailored CV. AI can make mistakes; review every change. Text input/output only; does not access saved accounts, export PDFs or submit applications. Limited to 2 calls per day per network.

cvText.description: Relevant CV or resume text, at least 80 characters after trimming. Omit contact details and sensitive identifiers.

jobDescription.description: The job posting as plain text, at least 80 characters after trimming. The CV and job posting together must fit in 20000 UTF-8 bytes when encoded as JSON, including JSON syntax and escapes.

name: tailor_cv
title: Tailor CV to a job
